records.claim_boundary: An instantiation on ONE graph family (the unit path), ONE scheme (the explicit stepper phi <- phi - dt * L_R phi), one smooth datum family plus one rough datum, a FIVE-level tape (at most 129 nodes, 256 steps). Window certificates only: nothing is stated about a level beyond 4, a tail, a limit or the continuum heat equation (a Dr readout); h -> 0 is never formed; no convergence or continuum-limit theorem is stated or follows. An ACCEPT certifies the ledger it is given, not the model, the datum or the reader: two declared FAIL controls on the rough datum are certified, pass the informative held-out test and are ACCEPTed (TR_near is compiled as exactly that), and a conserved reader certifies the unstable tape. Under the full-tape certificate the conclusion of an ACCEPT concerns two values already on the tape and has no predictive content; the only held-out statements are the C3 / C4 observations.
honest_caveats: INSTANTIATION / OCCURRENCE RECORD, not a row. Every new object of the file (N4 plateau_radius_window and its contrapositive, the tuple-carrier maps, dinf5, the leaf suppliers) is NEW DERIVATION / PROPOSAL -- not yet in Toledo.

Two layers that are NOT composed in Coq: S1 / S3 / S5 on scalar ledgers (constant q_K, identity maps) and S2 / S4 on a separate small tuple grid whose data are declared vectors, not heat states of the run; the state-layer ledger O_state (a path-length ledger, proposal N3) is not a Coq object. Levels 1-4 of the tapes are not recomputed in Coq (level 0 is, for six rows). Seven of the run's 40 rows.

leaf_gate is window-local and parametric in kappa: as a definition it can license more than the frozen protocol's full-tape gate, which is its instance kappa := khat_5. On the run's numbers an exact-fraction model of the definition (finite_diagnostic, 2026-09-18, not a Coq readout) reproduces the run's ACCEPT / HOLD staircase on all 40 rows at that instance, and finds five NO-LICENCE rows of the run on which some kappa < 1 is locally licensed at K = 1 or 2 -- on those rows the for-every-kappa HOLD theorem shape is false. A full-tape licence inside leaf_cert, and the exclusion of K = top - 1 inside it, are open design decisions.

Run record (finite_diagnostic): 4 matched pairs (same reader, ACCEPT at the stable step, HOLD at the unstable step), all from the pinned tapes, every FAIL half a blow-up (kappa_0 >= 2.7e3); held-out MISS of the one-ratio certificate C3 on 5 of 10 tested PASS-candidate rows (C3 is not a regime classifier), of C4 on 0 of 10; open predictions 225 tallied / 42 misses (227 / 44 if two untallied out-of-bracket ratios are counted); hand-derivation, regression and forced-by-arithmetic classes 172 items / 0 misses.

Three independent refuters (numbers / Coq / prose-vs-formal) ran on 2026-09-18: no theorem was found false; the prose-vs-formal lens refuted the file's description of HOLD ('third value') and of the gate, both corrected in the fixer pass whose recompile is the readout quoted above.
